content.short: FrenBot is a social trading bot on Cardano that simplifies token swaps and liquidity sniping via Telegram and Discord.
content.description: FrenBot is a sophisticated social trading bot designed to lower the barrier to entry for trading Cardano native tokens. By integrating directly with Telegram and Discord, FrenBot allows users to execute trades and monitor liquidity pools through simple chat commands, bypassing complex DEX interfaces. Key features include lightning-fast token swaps and liquidity sniping, giving retail traders the speed and tools typically reserved for professionals. As a Project Catalyst funded initiative, FrenBot continues to expand its feature set to enhance the user experience for the Cardano community.
